verified_features: Completed cache validates generation and scoring identities, every answer/score record, prediction rows and recomputed summary
Score records bind to exact saved response digests
Actual HF rendered template preflight reserves output tokens before device transfer; no tokenizer truncation
GGUF native prompt count and older-server apply-template/tokenize fallback with count readback
Immutable tensor checkpoint payloads with atomic identity/hash/audit pointers
Atomic safetensor shard writes and index commit
Bound per-step conversion ledger resumes verified BF16/Q4 steps after Q5 interruption
Independent finalized reflinks or streamed copies, never working-file hardlinks
Atomic staged release commit, exact release file hash/size index and idempotent identity checks
Actual verify-release console succeeds on an intact fixture and rejects changed files
Zero-edit and repeated reset preserve logits, generated tokens and original weight storage
Malformed/nonfinite/nonorthogonal edits fail without leaving partial active layers
remaining: Real B70 baseline/edit/export/reload/Q4/Q5 smoke is separate: runs/real-b70-roundtrip/verification.json. Consult its actual status, not this implementation report.
